remarks: Remarks: Beautiful & Rare Victorian in the Roy-Hart School district! Voted "Best Place to Raise Children" (top 11) by Business Week Magazine. Step into timeless charm with this stunning Victorian home, perfectly set on a spacious double lot. Original character shines throughout, including elegant pocket doors, while thoughtful updates provide comfort and convenience. Enjoy endless entertaining with a private party cabana, large patio space, and fenced-in area right off the house. Car enthusiasts and hobbyists will love the attached and detached garages—complete with heat, storage, and workbench. The attached garage even includes a hot tub for the ultimate relaxation retreat. An extra-long and wide driveway provides ample parking for gatherings of any size. There are two (2) 30 amp plugs outside each garage for the visiting campers, etc. Inside, updated electric, plumbing, roof (with 43 years of life left), some replacement windows and back up sump pump. Basement has been professionally heightened with a concrete floor, making it a very modern basement. The cement for the drivewayand outdoor room was poured 6" thick, will last a lifetime. AirBNB possibility? Located within walking distance to Roy-Hart schools, all village amenities and the historic Erie Canal. This one-of-a-kind property combines historic charm with modern lifestyle features. Showings begin immediately. VR pricing, seller will consider offers from 399,900-460k
